designations.note: HK G3 technical data: 'Length of twist, permanently to the righthand 12.00 in. (305.00 mm)'; 'Number of the grooves 4'. 305 mm agrees with the 7.62x51 standard (304.8 mm). The G3 was the Federal German Army standard rifle from 1959 (InfoBrief Heer 2022).
Early Bundeswehr variant of the HK G3. Twist taken from the G3 technical data (305 mm, one turn in 12 in).
Bundeswehr variant of the HK G3. Twist taken from the G3 technical data (305 mm).
The G3 manual documents the G3A3 (rigid butt stock) and gives twist 305 mm (one turn in 12 in).
The G3 manual documents the G3A4 (retractable butt stock); twist 305 mm as G3A3.
HK spare parts list: 'Spare parts list for G3K Rifle, cal. 7.62 mm x 51 NATO'. Twist from G3 technical data (305 mm, one turn in 12 in).
Short carbine version of the G3 (A4 butt stock). Twist from G3 technical data (305 mm).
Sniper variant of the G3 with telescopic sight; documented in the Hensoldt sight instructions 'Sniper Rifles G3 SG1 and HK 33 SG1'. Twist from G3 technical data (305 mm).
InfoBrief Heer lists 'Praezisionsgewehre G3ZF, G3ZF-DMR'. ZF = Zielfernrohr (telescopic sight) G3. Twist from G3 technical data (305 mm).
InfoBrief Heer lists G3ZF-DMR as the last G3 version still in Bundeswehr service. Twist from G3 technical data (305 mm).

HK G11 technical data: 'Rifling twist length 155 mm (6.101 in) (Right hand twist)', calibre 4.73 mm x 33. No chambering standard is given in the task, so no comparison applies. Development programme, not fielded.
The G95k article calls the G27 the 'Unterstuetzungswaffe G27 (HK417)'. HK417 technical data: 'Groove/land profile, 4 grooves, right-hand twist 280 mm'. Differs from the 7.62x51 standard (304.8 mm).
Short (k = kurz) version of the G27 HK417. Twist 280 mm as HK417 technical data. Differs from the 7.62x51 standard (304.8 mm).

HK G28E technical data (G28 E2 Standard and E3 Patrol): 'Barrel profile | Twist ... groove/land profile, 4 grooves | 305 mm (12")'. 305 mm agrees with the 7.62x51 standard (304.8 mm). The G28 is the Bundeswehr designated marksman rifle (InfoBrief Heer 2022).
HK G36 technical data (G36, G36K, G36C): 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, right-hand twist 178 mm'. 178 mm agrees with the 5.56x45 standard (177.8 mm).
Bundeswehr variant of the G36. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
Bundeswehr variant of the G36. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
G36A3 named in the G95k article (HK269 can be adapted to the G36A3). Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
InfoBrief Heer: the G36 midlife improvements are the 'Varianten G36A4 und G36kA4'. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
HK G36 technical data G36C column (barrel 228 mm): 'Groove/land profile, right-hand twist 178 mm'.
HK G36 technical data G36K column (barrel 318 mm): 'Groove/land profile, right-hand twist 178 mm'.
Bundeswehr short (k) variant of the G36. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
Bundeswehr short (k) variant of the G36. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
Bundeswehr short (k) variant of the G36. Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
G36KA4 named in the G95k article (keyhole interface introduced with the G36KA4). Twist from HK G36 technical data (178 mm).
WTR 2023: the special-forces G95 is a variant of the HK416A7; the new G95A1/G95KA1 are 'G95-Varianten'. HK416 technical data: 'Groove/land profile, 6 grooves, right-hand twist 178 mm'.
G95k article: 'Beim G95k (HK416A7) handelt es sich ...'; Kandidatenwaffe HK416A7, barrel length 368 mm (14.5 in). Twist from HK416 technical data (178 mm).
WTR 2023: the new Bundeswehr standard rifle is the G95A1 (commercial designation HK416 A8-16.5 in), calibre 5.56 mm x 45. Twist from HK416 technical data (178 mm).
WTR 2023: the short G95KA1 is the HK416 A8-14 in; 'die Waffe weist ... nur durch die Rohrlaenge (aehnlich G36 und G36K)' different. Twist from HK416 technical data (178 mm).

designations.weapon: Barrett M107 (Bundeswehr G82A1, supplied by Heckler & Koch)
designations.note: InfoBrief Heer: 'Scharfschuetzengewehr grosser Reichweite G82A1'; footnote: 'Durch Heckler & Koch in spezieller Bw-Konfiguration geliefert; Waffe hergestellt durch Fa. Barrett/US.' No twist is published in the source. No HK twist stated; the 12.7x99 standard is 381 mm.
MG3 Operator's Manual 1992, cal. 7.62 mm x 51: 'Type of twist constant, R/H'. The manual states right-hand twist only, with no length, so no twist value is recorded. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
Technical Manual for Machine Gun MG3e: 'Twist R/H', 'No. of rifles : 4', 'Length of rifled section 476 mm'. No turn length is stated.

HK MG4E technical data: 'Barrel profile | twist Groove/land profile, 6 grooves | right-hand twist'. HK Combined Catalog 2018: 'HK cold hammer forged barrel has land and groove rifling (6 groove) with right hand twist (1 in 7 inch/178 mm)'. 178 mm agrees with the 5.56x45 standard (177.8 mm).

HK121 technical data (HK121 I / U / S / EBW, cal. 7.62 mm x 51). InfoBrief Heer names the MG5 as the replacement for the MG3. The technical data states 'groove/land profile, 4 grooves | right-hand twist' with no length.
InfoBrief Heer names the MG5 family used by the Bundeswehr. Variant of the HK MG5 (HK121) in 7.62 mm x 51. No twist length is published. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
InfoBrief Heer: 'MG5A2 - die Kurzrohrversion' (short-barrel version). No twist length is published. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
HK MP5 Submachine Gun Family document describes the MP5 series; the operator manuals state cal. 9 mm x 19. No twist length is published in the HK MP5 documents held. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.
MP5 family document: 'MP5A2 - A2 denotes weapon is fitted with a fixed buttstock'. No twist length published.
MP5 family document: 'MP5A3 - ... Same as MP5A2 but fitted with retractable buttstock'. No twist length published.
HK MP5A4/A5 Instruction Manual. MP5 family document: 'MP5A4 - Same as MP5A2 but with 3-round burst firing'. No twist length published.
HK MP5A4/A5 Instruction Manual. MP5 family document: 'MP5A5 - Same as MP5A3 but with 3-round burst firing'. No twist length published.
HK MP5K Operator's Manual, cal. 9 mm x 19, barrel 115 mm. No twist length is stated (only barrel length and muzzle velocity). The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.
MP5 family document lists MP5KA1 (short MP5K with smooth top, no optics). No twist length published.
MP5 family document: 'Same as the MP5K but with 3-round burst firing'. No twist length published.
MP5 family document: 'N denotes Navy version. Same as MP5K ...'. No twist length published.
HK MP5K-PDW manual (2252330). MP5 family document describes the MP5K-PDW (Personal Defense Weapon). No twist length published.
MP5 family document lists the MP5SD1 to MP5SD6 suppressed models. The suppressor is integral; no twist length published.
MP5 family document: Navy (N) version of the MP5SD. No twist length published.
MP5 family document: Navy version of the MP5 (MP5-N). No twist length published.
MP5 family document: 'SF stands for Single-fire. Same as MP5A2 ...'. No twist length published.
MP5 family document references the MP5/10 (10 mm Auto). No chambering standard is given in the task and no twist length is published.
MP5 family document references the MP5/40 (.40 S&W). No twist length is published.

HK MP7A1 technical data, cal. 4.6 mm x 30. HK Product Catalog 2009: '7-inch cold-hammer forged barrel with right hand twist rifling (1 turn in 6.3 inches)'. 6.3 in = 160.0 mm, which differs from the 4.6x30 standard (150 mm).
HK MP7A1 technical data (4.6 mm x 30). Twist 1 turn in 6.3 in = 160.0 mm from HK Product Catalog 2009; differs from the 4.6x30 standard (150 mm).
HK MP7 product page lists the MP7 A1 and MP7 A2 variants. Twist as MP7 (1 turn in 6.3 in = 160.0 mm, HK Product Catalog 2009); differs from the 4.6x30 standard (150 mm).
HK P7 Series Operator's Manual, cal. 9 mm x 19. No turn length is stated. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm. Named as a Bundeswehr pistol in InfoBrief Heer 2022.
HK P8 Operator's Manual: 'Kaliber 9 mm x 19'; 'Drallaenge ... 250 mm' (English: 'Twist Length ... 250 mm'). 250 mm agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK P9S manual (covers the P9/P9S family), cal. 9 mm x 19. No turn length is stated.
HK P9S manual, cal. 9 mm x 19. No turn length is stated.

HK P30/P30L/P30SK Operator's Manual: cal. 9 mm x 19; 'Barrel profile / twist Hexagonal / right-hand'. Twist length 250 mm is stated in the HK P30 manual specification table ('Twist Length 250 mm (9.84 in.)'). Agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK P30/P30L/P30SK Operator's Manual. Twist length 250 mm from the HK P30 manual specification table. Agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK P30/P30L/P30SK Operator's Manual. Twist length 250 mm from the HK P30 manual specification table. Agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK P2000 Series Operator's Manual specification table: 'Twist Length 250 mm (9.84 in.)'. Agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK P2000 Series Operator's Manual specification table: 'Twist Length 250 mm (9.84 in.)'. Agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK VP70Z Instruction Manual, cal. 9 mm x 19. No turn length is stated. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.
HK4 Automatic Pistol manual: four interchangeable calibres (.380 ACP, .32 ACP, .25 ACP, .22 LR). No turn length is stated. No chambering standard is given in the task.

HK USP Operator's Manual specification table: 'Twist Length 380 mm (14.96 in.) / 250 mm (9.84 in.) / 406 mm (15.98 in.)' for .40 S&W / 9 mm x 19 / .45 ACP. 9 mm value 250 mm agrees with the 9x19 standard. Other values: .40 S&W 380 mm, .45 ACP 406 mm (agrees with the .45 ACP standard of 406.4 mm).
HK USP Compact Operator's Manual: USP45 Compact 406 mm, USP40 Compact 378 mm, USP357 Compact 378 mm, USP9 Compact 250 mm. 9 mm value 250 mm agrees with the 9x19 standard.

HK USP Tactical manual (addition to the USP Operator's Manual); offered in 9 mm x 19, .40 S&W and .45 ACP. Twist from the USP Operator's Manual: .45 ACP 406 mm, 9 mm 250 mm, .40 S&W 380 mm. 406 mm agrees with the .45 ACP standard (406.4 mm).
HK USP Expert Instruction Manual: 'Twist length ... 250 mm 380 mm 406 mm' for 9 mm x 19 / .40 S&W / .45 ACP. 9 mm value 250 mm agrees with the 9x19 standard.
HK Match USP Instruction Manual (.45 ACP). No turn length is stated in the manual. The .45 ACP standard is 406.4 mm.
HK Mark 23 Operator's Manual specification table: 'Rifling polygonal bore right hand twist'. The manual states the profile and direction but no turn length. The .45 ACP standard is 406.4 mm.
HK Mark 23 Operator's Manual: cal. .45 ACP; 'Rifling polygonal bore right hand twist'. No turn length stated.
HK UMP 45 / UMP 40 Operator's Manual. HK Product Catalog 2009 also lists the UMP 9 mm. Twist is stated per calibre (see UMP40, UMP45); no single value applies to the multi-calibre designation.
HK Product Catalog 2009: 'The 9mm model of the UMP, the UMP9'. No turn length is published for the 9 mm UMP. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.

HK UMP 40 Operator's Manual specification table: 'Twist length ... 377 mm (14.84 in)'; 'Bore profile 6x polygonal, right-hand twist'. No .40 S&W standard is given in the task, so no comparison applies.
HK UMP 45 Operator's Manual specification table: 'Twist length ... 406 mm (15.98 in)'; 'Bore profile 6x polygonal, right-hand twist'. 406 mm agrees with the .45 ACP standard (406.4 mm).
HK USC Operator's Manual specification table: 'Barrel profile / twist 6x polygonal profile, right-hand twist'; 'Twist length 406 mm'. 406 mm agrees with the .45 ACP standard (406.4 mm).
HK SL8-1 manual specification table: 'Rifling 6X lands & grooves, right hand twist, 1 turn in 7 inches'. 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm, which agrees with the 5.56x45 standard.
HK SL8-1 manual: cal. .223 Remington; '1 turn in 7 inches' = 177.8 mm.
HK PSG1 Instruction Manual: 'Direction of rifling twist ... Right-hand'. No turn length is stated. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
HK PSG1A1 variant covered by the PSG1 instruction documents. No turn length is stated.
HK MSG90 Instruction Manual, cal. 7.62 mm x 51. No turn length is stated. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
HK MSG90A1 variant covered by the MSG90 instruction documents. No turn length is stated.
HK HK11 A1 Brief Description, cal. 7.62 mm x 51, barrel 450 mm. No turn length is stated. The 7.62x51 standard is 304.8 mm.
HK HK11 A1 Brief Description: 'Technical Data HK 11 A1, Calibre 7.62 mm'. No turn length is stated.
HK HK21E Spare Parts List: 'Barrel, incompl., 22 in, 1 in 12 in twist'. 1 turn in 12 in = 304.8 mm; the list states 305 mm. Agrees with the 7.62x51 standard.
HK HK21E Spare Parts List: 7.62 mm barrel, '1 in 12 in twist' = 305 mm. Agrees with the 7.62x51 standard.
HK HK23E Spare Parts List: 'Spare parts list for Machine Gun HK23 E, cal. 5.56 mm x 45'. No turn length is stated. The 5.56x45 standard is 177.8 mm.
HK HK23E Spare Parts List, cal. 5.56 mm x 45. No turn length is stated.
HK HK33/HK53 Instruction Manual, cal. 5.56 mm x 45. No turn length is stated. The 5.56x45 standard is 177.8 mm.
Export version of the HK33, cal. 5.56 mm x 45, covered by the HK33 documents. No turn length is stated.
HK HK53 Spare Parts List header: 'Submachine Gun HK53, Twist 178 mm'. 178 mm agrees with the 5.56x45 standard (177.8 mm).

HK HK416 Technical Data: 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, 6 grooves, right-hand twist 178 mm'. The HK416 Operator's Manual states 'Barrel twist: 178 mm (1 in 7 in right hand twist)'. Agrees with the 5.56x45 standard.

HK HK417 Technical Data: 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, 4 grooves, right-hand twist 280 mm'. HK Product Catalog 2009 and the 2018 catalog state 1 in 11 in (279.4 mm). Differs from the 7.62x51 standard (304.8 mm).

HK HK433 Brochure: 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, 6 grooves, right-hand twist, 178 mm'. Agrees with the 5.56x45 standard. The HK433 was the competing candidate in the Bundeswehr System Sturmgewehr competition (WTR 2023).

HK HK437 Handbook technical data: 'Calibre .300 BLK (7.62 mm x 35)'; 'Barrel profile, twist, direction 4 groove rifling, 8 in / 203 mm right-hand twist'. 8 in = 203.2 mm. No chambering standard is given in the task.

HK 40 mm Systems catalogue: AG36 add-on grenade launcher, 40 mm x 46 (low velocity). HK G36 Technical Data (AG36 A1): 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, right-hand twist 1200 mm'. No chambering standard is given in the task.
HK 40 mm Systems catalogue: AG36 A1 differs from the AG36 by an additional LLM adapter. Twist 1200 mm from HK G36 Technical Data (AG36 A1).
HK GLM Info Sheet: 40 mm x 46 add-on grenade launcher for the HK416/HK417. HK416 Technical Data (GLM HK416/417): 'Barrel profile/twist Groove/land profile, 6 grooves, right-hand twist 1200 mm'.

HK 40 mm Systems catalogue: GMG E, 40 mm x 53, automatic grenade machine gun. InfoBrief Heer names the 'Granatmaschinenwaffe 40mm GraMaWa'. No twist length is published. No chambering standard is given in the task.
HK Combined Catalog 2018 names the HK169 as a 40 mm add-on grenade launcher for the HK417 A2 (with the GLM, M320 and HK269). No twist length is published.

WTR 2023: the HK269 is a 40 mm add-on device for the G95 family ('Anbaugeraet HK269', 'Kaliber 40mm Low Velocity') that would replace the AG36 and the Granatpistole 40 mm (HK69). No twist length is published.
US Army M320 Grenade Launcher Guide (the M320 is the US designation of the HK AG36-derived launcher). No twist length is published.

TM-E 30-451 (US War Department, 1945), 'Machine Pistols: MP. (Maschinenpistole) 40': 'This machine pistol was developed from the blowback-operated MP. 38'. Caliber '9 mm'. No twist is stated. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.
Catalog of Enemy Ordnance Materiel (US Army, 1945): 'Submachine Gun, M. P. 43' and '7.92 mm ... M. P. 43; M. P. 43/1; Sturmgewehr 44'. TM-E 30-451 also describes the MP. 43/1. No twist is stated.
Catalog of Enemy Ordnance Materiel (1945): 'The various models of this weapon, including the M. P. 43, M. P. 43/1, and M. P. 44, have been officially designated M. P. 44.' No twist is stated.

Catalog of Enemy Ordnance Materiel (1945): the MP. 43, MP. 43/1 and MP. 44 were 'officially designated M. P. 44'; 'A recent official German order changed the nomenclature to Sturmgewehr 44.' No twist is stated.
Catalog of Enemy Ordnance Materiel (1945): 'A recent official German order changed the nomenclature to Sturmgewehr 44.' No twist is stated.
TM-E 30-451 (1945), Figure 11: 'Fallschirmjaegergewehr 42, caliber 7.92 mm automatic rifle'. No twist is stated.
TM-E 30-451 (1945): 'M.G. 34, caliber 7.92 mm'. No twist is stated.
TM-E 30-451 (1945), Figure 14: 'M.G. 42, caliber 7.92 mm, on bipod mount'. No twist is stated.
Catalog of Enemy Ordnance Materiel (1945), index of small arms: '9 mm M. P. 18 (Bergmann)'. No twist is stated. The 9x19 standard is 250 mm.
